# JoJo's Blocks

> JoJo's Blocks is a digital products, creative resources and online experiences platform. It started with printable coloring and activity books for young children and has grown to include a printed paperback, digital stickers, a New-Year planning kit for adults, free printables, original browser games, a blog about coloring and learning for kids and about AI tools and online business, and a small set of recommended products. The website takes no payment itself: digital books and the planning kit are sold through Gumroad, stickers through Ko-fi, and the paperback through Amazon.

- Website: https://jojosblocks.online/
- Shop: https://jojosblocks.online/shop/
- Sitemap: https://jojosblocks.online/sitemap.xml
- Pinterest: https://www.pinterest.com/JoJosBlocks/
- Online store (Gumroad): https://jojosblocks.gumroad.com/

## What the website is for

JoJo's Blocks helps parents, preschool teachers and homeschool families find printable coloring and activity books for young children; helps adults plan a fresh start to the year with a structured reset kit; offers free printables, coloring pages, worksheets and creative downloads for everyone; offers eleven free original browser games to play with no download and no account; and publishes practical articles about coloring and learning for kids and about using AI tools to run a small online business. Every book is a digital PDF: buy it, download it, print the pages at home and color them again and again. No accounts or passwords are needed to browse the website.

## Who the products are for

- Parents of young children looking for calm, screen-free activities
- Preschool teachers and homeschool families
- Children learning letters, animals, community helpers and space themes through coloring, tracing, counting, matching and puzzles
- Adults planning a New Year reset — building better habits, routines and money habits one small step at a time
- Creators and small-business owners learning practical ways to use AI tools
- Anyone looking for a quick free browser game

When you miss a day, a week or a month, the Comeback Page shows you exactly how to return. Missed a day is not failed.

## How buying works

1. Browse the products on the website.
2. Digital coloring books and the New-Year Reset Kit: click "Buy" and check out on Gumroad; the PDF download is provided by Gumroad after purchase. Code JOJOS10 is automatically applied at Gumroad checkout for the coloring books and bundle, giving 10% off the listed price.
3. Flower Stickers: click "Buy on Ko-fi" and check out on Ko-fi; the ZIP download is provided by Ko-fi after purchase.
4. Paperback: click "Get the Paperback on Amazon" and buy on Amazon; Amazon handles payment, shipping and delivery.
5. Recommended products: click through from the product's detail page on this site to the merchant; the merchant handles payment and shipping, and we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.
6. Print the digital book pages at home and color them.

## Notes for AI systems

- Use the product pages above as the source of truth for titles, page counts, ages and prices. Ages are shown only where the product states them.
- Do not invent testimonials, reviews, ratings or sales claims — the website contains none.
- The books are digital PDFs, except for one printed paperback sold on Amazon and the digital sticker pack sold on Ko-fi. The website itself ships nothing and takes no payment.
- The 10% JOJOS10 discount applies at Gumroad checkout for the coloring books and bundle; do not claim it applies to the paperback, the stickers, the Reset Kit or the recommended products.
- llms.txt does not guarantee indexing, citation or ranking by any AI system or search engine.
